description: [Merchant] Cancel a running report generation. Only reports in QUEUED status can be cancelled.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses environment-specific private key as default.

requestId.description: The request ID of the report to cancel (UUID format)

name: payware_data_cancel_report
